description: Wait until an order's on-chain status changes (or the timeout ends) and return the same view as get_order_status. Use it instead of calling get_order_status in a loop. Default 120 s, max 300 s; call it again while changed is false.

escrowVersion.description: Escrow version the order lives in. Default: the current one. Use 2 for orders created before v3.

sinceStatus.description: The status you last saw. Returns at once if the order is already in another one. Default: its status when the call starts.

name: wait_for_order_update
